It’s an autoimmune disease characterized by inflammation in the affected area. It involves swelling in the vertebrae and can lead to stiffness, chronic pain, and reduced mobility. In advanced cases, this inflammation can cause the vertebrae to fuse together, resulting in a loss of spinal flexibility and a hunched-forward posture. Dr Bhavin Shial best spine specialist in Mumbai provides effective treatment for Spondylitis. Normally these discs between each vertebra, provide cushioning to the joints. Sometimes, the disc becomes weak or damaged, cracking the annulus (outer layer of disc) causing a rupture. When the annulus is torn, then the nucleus populous (soft interior of disc) extrudes out, protruding through the exterior layer and extending outwards resulting in compression of the adjacent nerve roots and spinal cord within the spinal column, this is called a disc herniation or a slipped disc. Most of the time, disk herniation will improve with nonsurgical treatment. featured_reviews.name: Akshay Chavan
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited this clinic for severe sciatica and met Dr. Sandeep Jain. I clearly explained that my back pain was unbearable and my right leg was not functioning properly — I couldn’t even walk for 5 minutes. Instead of doing the basic required tests like an X-ray or MRI to understand what was actually wrong, he directly told me to do only a blood test.
The blood test showed a Vitamin D deficiency, and based on that he prescribed just paracetamol, aciclo chlorhexabine, and Gen D Nano for 3 weeks. I followed everything exactly, but my condition became WORSE day by day. My leg pain increased so much that even standing became difficult.
I honestly don’t think this is how a responsible doctor should treat a patient with serious nerve-related symptoms. My experience with him was very disappointing.
